SEN.note: Presidential call for sovereignty and no certified health-data host are not a rule or hosting.

facts.fact: Dr Khaliloullah Dia, head of the Ministry of Health's digital department, said the single shared patient record is in a test phase at two hospitals, Abass Ndao in Dakar and Kaffrine, with more to be enrolled; the tier of the hospitals is not stated.
The Ministry of Health's digital department leads the single shared patient record, which Dr Dia said the government asked the ministry to make a priority.
